newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign firms top half of Shanghai foreign trade.
newsitem.headline: Foreign firms top half of Shanghai foreign trade.

text.p: Foreign-invested firms accounted for 56.7 percent of Shanghai's total foreign trade in 1996, up from 47.8 percent in 1995, the Business News reported on Friday.
The newspaper quoted statistics from the Shanghai Customs Bureau as saying international trade by foreign firms in Shanghai grew 32.6 percent in 1996, reaching $14.8 billion.
Exports by foreign firms in Shanghai increased 35.6 percent to $5.4 billion in 1996 and imports rose 31 percent to $9.4 billion, it said.
